Check this file in to both repos, replacing the one that is there:

  • godot-sandbox/godot-sandbox/resources/codex/codex_balance.json: the game reads it at boot and on every hit.
  • picotron-playtesting/dist/mining-mike-codex/codex_balance.json: this page reads it.

What changed

    A dev tool, not a player screen. Numbers are the game's own: GameConfig (the .tres, under any override in codex_balance.json), the scripts that own the rest (read-only here), and the armour and weapon multipliers in codex_balance.json, which the game reads at every hit. Models are the ones the game ships, measured in the running game. PROPOSED marks the one part still a design: the player-facing knowledge tiers and what they pay. Built by docs/mockups/gen_bestiary.py.
